note: All 168 bundles read (pivots almost all Early Modern Irish annals/Keating prose; partners mostly late Greek prose). No claims. Leads tested and rejected: BC-ddd82 Ir. 'ni thuc troigh theithid' (never gave a foot of flight; formula recurs 3-4x in CELT) vs Serb. 'da od vraga ne uteče traga' (Vuk 21700:1053, a one-off in Vuk, rhyme-driven): *tekw- shared, but traig/trag cognacy doubtful and the figures differ (refusing to retreat vs annihilating the enemy). BC-c2f1a Ir. 'snechta mor isin errach' ~ ON 'vár kom ok snjó leysti' ~ Lith. 'vasaros sniegu': *wesr- + *snoygwh- co-occur, but this is generic weather language and the contexts differ (annal notice / saga narrative / wedding-song adynaton).
